name: Harumi Ena
source:
[b]Guitarist & Vocalist of [i]Lemonade Factory[/i][/b]

A girl who transfers into the [url=/c153631]protagonist[/url]'s school.
She usually maintains a calm demeanor, but she also has a tendency to charge ahead once she gets an idea in her head.
She is actually severely nearsighted.
